Embed Any ToolAspect Widget

Every one of our 652 tools ships as a free, self-contained embed. Grab a copy-paste iframe snippet or the WordPress variant below, or use the @coreaspect/toolaspect-embed web component. Free with attribution: keep the “Powered by ToolAspect” link (dofollow) under the widget.

652 widgetsNo signupiframe + WordPress + web componentMobile friendly

Quick start

The iframe snippet for any tool follows this pattern (replace slug):

<iframe src="https://toolaspect.com/embed/<slug>/" width="100%" height="520" style="border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px" title="Tool — ToolAspect" loading="lazy"></iframe>
<p style="font-size:.75rem;text-align:right;margin:4px 0 0">Powered by <a href="https://toolaspect.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ToolAspect</a></p>

Web component alternative: <toolaspect-tool tool="slug"></toolaspect-tool> via @coreaspect/toolaspect-embed.
